titleZh: 節儉 ↔ 揮霍｜存錢筒對碎鈔機
hook: frugal／husband（勤儉）抱存錢筒，profligate／lavish 餵碎鈔機——會計在旁邊默默流淚。
script: 節儉隊：frugal／thrifty／provident／sparing／husband。揮霍隊：profligate／lavish／extravagant／spendthrift。口令：存錢筒寫「能省則省」，碎鈔機寫「今夜不回家」。

members.senseAnchor: careful to buy only what is necessary
members.speakLineEn: Cue the 存錢筒: frugal walks on and the gag sticks.
members.speakLineZh: 請「存錢筒」出場：frugal 一上場梗就黏住——節儉的。
